candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Text fully accurate including V₁ subscript and 一対. Table restructured with an odd empty header row spanning four columns rather than the ground-truth layout of one left label column; underlines on example words (先輩, 好き, できる, etc.) not preserved. Right-aligned parenthetical (やりたいかどうか…) approximated with spaces.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes:
Errors: 「ー対」uses long-vowel mark instead of 一 (一対); brackets rendered as 【】 instead of [ ]; V lacks the subscript ₁ (V₁ in image). Table collapsed into a single row using
, which loses the row alignment; underlines not preserved; example indentation lost.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Most faithful: 5-column table mirrors the boxed layout, V₁[辞書形]/V₁[ない] correct, 一対 correct, paragraph leading spaces and example indentation reproduced. Only losses are the underlines on example words and exact right-alignment of the final parenthetical note.

rationale: C is best: its table structure most closely mirrors the boxed 接続の形 layout, all characters (including V₁ and 一対) are correct, and indentation is preserved; its only shortfall is the missing underlines, common to all candidates. A has equally accurate text but a slightly awkward table restructuring (empty spanning header row) that deviates from the visual layout. B ranks last due to actual character errors (ー instead of 一 in 一対, 【】 instead of [ ], missing V₁ subscript) and a collapsed single-row table that loses the layout.
